# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 3: Nova Elysia Three Religious Paths, Western Pantheon & Pyrophoroi/Copper-Clad Military (oe_eln_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_elysia_faith_military.py; edit the generator, not this file.

on_religion_changed = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_eln_on_religion_changed
	}
}

monthly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_eln_semiannual_pulse
	}
}

# Immediately purge the 2 New World deities for ANY country converting to hellenism_religion
# unless explicitly seated on Nova Elysia (enforces v9.8 <= 6 active gods GUI invariant).
oe_eln_on_religion_changed = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
	}
	effect = {
		oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
		oe_eln_enforce_six_god_cap = yes
	}
}

# Lightweight rebel-guarded semiannual pulse (months 5 & 11, staggered from v9.8 months 4 & 10):
# - Enforces the <= 6 active gods invariant on all hellenism_religion countries.
# - Dispatches Act II faith & military milestones (oe_eln.3-.11) for settled Nova Elysia.
oe_eln_semiannual_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		exists = religion
		OR = {
			current_month = 5
			current_month = 11
		}
		OR = {
			religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion
			oe_eln_is_elysia_host = yes
		}
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion }
			oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
			oe_eln_enforce_six_god_cap = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_eln_is_elysia_host = yes
				is_ai = no
			}
			oe_eln_faith_mil_dispatch = yes
		}
	}
}
